definitions.fees: Net gaming revenue (NGR) settled to the bankroll, measured as WINR received via ProfitReceived minus WINR paid out via LossCovered. This is an NGR figure standing in for a Fees field that conventionally carries GGR: gross wagered turnover is not observable on-chain because games run off-chain, and creator rewards, affiliate commissions and VIP cashback are already deducted in the off-chain escrow ledger before settlement. NGR is the most complete figure derivable from chain data, and this is a known limitation rather than an omission.
definitions.revenue: Zero. No protocol share is deducted on-chain - a 30 day reconciliation shows 100% of settled net gaming revenue accruing to bankroll liquidity providers through share price appreciation, with no leakage to any other on-chain party. The protocol does capture revenue at the application layer, but it is charged and accounted entirely off-chain and is not derivable from chain data, so it is deliberately not estimated here.

definitions.revenue: 10% of locker protocol cuts and vesting-locker deposit fees.

definitions.fees: LP fees generated by Diggers pools. Diggers is the only LP of every pool it creates, so all LP fees accrue to the protocol's harvest split. Fees are valued on the ETH leg of each swap.
definitions.revenue: The team share of ETH fees (on-chain teamShareWad, currently 30%) plus the 10% platform-token slice while the $DIG airdrop window is live.

definitions.fees: Trading fees paid by users on bot.fun bonding-curve buys and sells.
definitions.revenue: Trading fees remaining after creator and referral allocations. The protocol currently sends this share to the zero address.
definitions.holders: The protocol share of trading fees burned as native TIA.

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by traders across GIGA DEX Classic (stable + volatile) and BrownFi oracle-based pools, per-pair fee rate read on-chain.
definitions.revenue: Share of swap fees collected by the GIGA fee center for veGIGA stakers, read per pair on-chain (pair.protocolFee() on Classic, feeSplit on BrownFi): 100% on gauged pairs (pairs receiving GIGA emissions), 3% on non-gauged Classic pairs.
definitions.holders: Share of swap fees distributed to veGIGA stakers (all of the protocol's share).

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by users
definitions.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by users
definitions.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by traders on GIGA DEX CL pools, per the pool's fee tier.
definitions.revenue: Share of swap fees collected by the GIGA fee center for veGIGA stakers, read per pool from slot0.feeProtocol: 100% on gauged pools (pools receiving GIGA emissions), 3% on non-gauged pools.
definitions.holders: Share of swap fees distributed to veGIGA stakers (all of the protocol's share).

definitions.fees: 1.25% fee on every bonding-curve trade, 0.40% paid to the token creator and 0.85% allocated to the PEEPS.WTF platform and ecosystem.
definitions.revenue: 0.85% platform fee from every bonding-curve trade, allocated to the PEEPS.WTF platform and ecosystem.

definitions.fees: A 1.25% fee charged on the ETH leg of every bonding-curve buy and sell, read per trade from the Trade event's protocolFee and creatorFee fields. HoodMint has no launch fee and no graduation fee.
definitions.revenue: The protocol slice of the bonding-curve trade fee.

definitions.fees: The 1% Uniswap V3 pool fee paid on every swap of tokens launched via ArrowPad (measured on the WETH leg).
definitions.revenue: The protocol's immutable 20% share of the pool fees.

definitions.fees: All fees paid by traders on the Lighter Robinhood perpetuals deployment: maker, taker, transfer, withdrawal and liquidation fees. Scoped to perp markets (spot is tracked separately as lighter-spot).
definitions.revenue: Protocol revenue from maker, taker, transfer and withdrawal fees. Liquidation fees are excluded — they go to the LLP (see SupplySideRevenue).
definitions.holders: Fees going to governance token holders

definitions.fees: Builder code fees paid by users trading Hyperliquid perps via CCXT.
definitions.revenue: Builder code fees collected by CCXT from Hyperliquid perps trades.

definitions.fees: Builder code fees paid by users trading Hyperliquid perps via Owly.fi.
definitions.revenue: Builder code fees collected by Owly.fi from Hyperliquid perps trades.

definitions.fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers: for every trade, the face value of the debt (units) minus the loan tokens the borrower received (sellerAssets), i.e. the fixed-rate discount locked in at execution.
definitions.revenue: Protocol fees kept by Morpho: the settlement fee (taker-paid spread on each trade) plus the continuous fee accrued on new lender credit. Both are disabled at launch, so Revenue is currently 0.

definitions.fees: Router-skim fee deducted from every Swapped event (currently 0.60%), hard-capped at 1.00% per route.
definitions.revenue: All the router-skim fees deducted from each swap accrue to the protocol treasury.

definitions.fees: Total staking rewards by running validators on Hyperliquid.
definitions.revenue: Staking rewards commission collected by protocol.

definitions.fees: Fees extracted per round: 1% admin fee on all deployed ETH, 1% admin fee on the losers pool, and a 10% vault fee on the losers pool after admin. On rounds where nobody hit the winning block, the entire pot (minus the admin fee) is routed to the Treasury vault. Variable effective rate depending on winner/loser ratio.
definitions.revenue: All extracted fees: the sum of protocol revenue (admin fees) and holders revenue (vault fees).
definitions.holders: Vault fee ETH funds automated PEA buybacks — 95% of bought PEA is permanently burned, 5% is distributed to PEA stakers as yield.

definitions.fees: Total Uniswap V3 trading fees earned by all AutoRange vaults' positions, realized on rebalance or when the vault owner manually claims — the full amount before the platform/owner split.
definitions.revenue: The platform's performance-fee cut of those trading fees, set per-vault by PlatformConfig and capped by the vault owner.

definitions.fees: All fees generated by the protocol: the 1% trade fee on bonding-curve buys/sells, token taxes (curve phase and post-graduation DEX phase, counted when the TaxProcessor realizes them), and graduation fees (fixed migration fee + dust). Legs denominated in the launched tokens themselves are not counted.
definitions.revenue: Protocol revenue: the 1% curve trade fee, graduation fees, and the protocol fee bucket of tax dispatches. RH.fun has no protocol token, so there is no holders revenue and Revenue equals ProtocolRevenue.

definitions.fees: On Base/Robinhood: gross Doppler pool trading fees (2.5%), extrapolated from Squeeze’s 47.5% Doppler fee-collect receipts. On Solana: LaunchLab *platform* fees claimed to Squeeze’s claim wallet only (not creator/protocol/referral cuts).
definitions.revenue: Squeeze platform share — EVM: 47.5% of Doppler swap fees claimed via collectFees; Solana: LaunchLab platform fees to the claim wallet.

definitions.fees: Swap fees inferred from each swap's actual input minus the no-fee input required by the pre-swap reserve invariant for the observed output, the LP reserve-growth portion of borrow interest emitted by InterestAccrued, and protocol-retained lending fees minted to the Ammalgam fee recipient. Ammalgam swap fees are dynamic; see https://docs.ammalgam.xyz/docs/developer-guide/contracts/libraries/QuadraticSwapFees.
definitions.revenue: Protocol-retained lending fees minted to the Ammalgam fee recipient. No protocol fees are taken from swaps.

definitions.fees: Uniswap V3 swap fees accrued on each launched token's pool, collected via the AaroLauncher contract.
definitions.revenue: The 20% treasury share of collected swap fees.

definitions.fees: Gross accumulated ticket fees recognized when WindfallFeeShare emits FeeDistributed. Recognition is aligned with the allocation period so gross fees equal protocol revenue plus supply-side revenue in every reporting window.
definitions.revenue: The portion of each FeeDistributed amount allocated to hostTreasury. Donor shareholder payouts are excluded and classified as supply-side revenue.

definitions.fees: Net yield earned by Unitas strategies on XAUt-backed XGLD, estimated from the exchange rate increase credited to XGLD holders and their documented 80% share. Excludes the USDu product (tracked in fees/unitas-usdu).
definitions.revenue: The 10% of net strategy yield allocated to the Unitas treasury and platform operations.

definitions.fees: A flat 1% fee on every trade, valued in USDT0: charged by the bonding curve on legacy v1 tokens, and by the 1% Uniswap v3 pool tier on v2/v3 tokens. Buy-side pool fees are charged on the USDT0 input (exact); sell-side pool fees are charged in the traded token and valued as their USDT0 equivalent at that swap's own price (usdtOut/99).
definitions.revenue: 50% of every trade fee accrues to the Prismapad treasury.

definitions.fees: The 10% rake taken from every round's pot: 6% to veSTEEL stakers, 2% to the keeper, and 2% to the motherlode.
definitions.revenue: Gross profit: 6% distributed to veSTEEL stakers plus the 2% keeper cut.
definitions.holders: All staker rewards — the ETH distributed to veSTEEL stakers (RewardNotified events on VeSteelV2).

definitions.fees: Net Acquisition fees paid by NFT purchasers, plus settlement fees taken from listing backings.
definitions.revenue: Team share of the protocol's cut of acquisition and settlement fees, plus any fees diverted to FWA-token buybacks.
definitions.holders: FWA-token buybacks funded from protocol fees, plus retroactive scheduled buybacks funded from previously earned team fees.

definitions.fees: All Uniswap V3 trading fees collected by the positions each Tirelire Hypervisor manages, summed on-chain from ZeroBurn events.
definitions.revenue: The 10% performance fee taken from collected trading fees and sent to the protocol treasury (fees / fee, with the divisor read from each ZeroBurn event).

definitions.fees: Includes swap fees and bribes paid by protocols
definitions.revenue: Revenue going to the protocol + Token holder Revenue.
definitions.holders: Swap fees distributed to holders and all the bribes go to holders

definitions.fees: Quote-denominated swap fees from Hook Trade events plus token-launch payment events across configured suites. Legacy launch-token-denominated swap fees are excluded because reliable historical USD valuation is unavailable. Crypto uses token balances; Stocks use the event-time factory tick reference price under the documented $4,000 opening-cap convention, with historical DefiLlama prices only when that reference is unavailable.
definitions.revenue: Actual platform and protocol-owned fixed-component swap credits, plus token-launch fees. Includes anti-snipe surcharges, referral fallback and rounding retained by the protocol. Claims do not count again.

definitions.fees: Protocol fee deducted from the output token of each executed order. The rate is signed by the maker as part of the order and capped on-chain at 1%.
definitions.revenue: All the protocol fees deducted from the output token of each executed order. The router has no liquidity providers, so nothing is shared out.

definitions.fees: USDG token-creation fees plus all trading fees from BowYard's classic and Agent bonding curves and post-graduation DEX pools.
definitions.revenue: Fees paid to the BowYard protocol treasury: the full classic token-creation fee, the classic protocol share of curve/DEX fees, and the immutable 20% protocol share of Agent trading fees.

definitions.fees: 1% swap fees from bow.fun factory-launched Uniswap V3 pools on Robinhood Chain, filtered for pools with at least $1,000 TVL.
definitions.revenue: 65% of swap fees retained by the bow.fun protocol, filtered for pools with at least $1,000 TVL.

definitions.fees: Total swap fees, priced in the valued leg's token. Per-swap fee = amount x (pool.fee / 1e6) where pool.fee is the value live at the swap's block_time (sourced from init_dex plus every update_fee_and_revenue_cut call, window-joined via effective range). Exact-in swaps are valued on the input leg (amount_in call argument), exact-out swaps on the output leg (amount_out call argument). Per-pool token identity comes from the swap calls, with dex_call_init_dex as a fallback for pools that have never traded.
definitions.revenue: Jupiter's share of the protocol cut: fees x (revenue_cut/1e6) x 50%.
definitions.holders: Money going to governance token holders

definitions.fees: Total fees paid by users on AGNT: (1) the 1.095% Doppler V4 terminal pool fee on tokens launched via the launchpad on Base + Robinhood Chain, derived from the observed on-chain platform fee share (WETH on Base; WETH plus RWA numeraires — tokenized stocks like AAPL that a Robinhood launch pairs against, e.g. $BEER — on Robinhood, priced by DefiLlama; the unpriced launched-token leg is excluded, a conservative lower bound); plus (2) the 0.40% platform fee on in-app swaps (Base), measured as WETH + USDC paid by Relay to AGNT's app-fee recipient wallet; plus (3) fees from PonsV2 launches on Robinhood Chain, read from each token's AgntFeeWedge Split events (native-ETH leg = total user-paid fee); plus (4) native-ETH paid by buyers to mint AGNT's own AGNTS PFP collection on Robinhood Chain; plus (5) AGNTS activation fees on Robinhood Chain (ETH fee + $AGNTS cost, from the Activated event); plus (6) AGNTS NFT swap fees on Robinhood Chain (random packs and exact picks; the fee is read from the swap engine at each swap's block).
definitions.revenue: Fees kept by AGNT: the 32% platform share of launchpad pool fees (WETH released by the Doppler initializers on Base + Robinhood, to 0x5bF5805e…C5f0) plus 100% of the 0.40% swap fee (WETH + USDC paid by Relay on Base to the app-fee recipient wallets — 0x585b6854…0598 pre-repoint and 0x5bF5805e…C5f0 post-repoint) plus AGNT's ~2/7 (28.57%) protocol cut of PonsV2 launch fees on Robinhood (the `toAgnt` leg of each AgntFeeWedge Split; the remaining 5/7 is forwarded to each token's own engine) plus 100% of AGNTS NFT mint proceeds on Robinhood (a first-party collection, so there is no creator split) plus 100% of AGNTS activation ETH fees and swap fees, and the full $AGNTS activation cost (the treasury share plus the burned share).
definitions.holders: The share of each AGNTS activation's $AGNTS cost that is burned (burnBps, 50% today).

definitions.fees: The 10% rake taken from every round's wagers: 8% distributed to veNFT stakers plus 2% routed to the vault.
definitions.revenue: All staker rewards — the ETH distributed to veNFT stakers (RewardDistributed events on CashVoteEscrowStaking).
definitions.holders: All staker rewards — the ETH distributed to veNFT stakers.

definitions.fees: Every plant pays an admin fee at the configured adminFeeBps rate (1% at time of writing) on the AAPL it buys — taken inside the plant on v1, and at the round's seal on v2 (where AAPL-denominated plants pay the same rate on their value and batched plants an extra batchFeeBps, 0 at time of writing). Every revealed round with a winner pays that round's configured rakeBps on the loss pool (the stakes on the 24 plots that did not bloom), split into a fixed 10% to SEED stakers (STAKERS_BPS, a contract constant), the round's configured jackpotBps share to the Golden Apple jackpot, and the remainder to the treasury. Rounds where the blooming plot is empty take no rake — the whole pot rolls into the jackpot.
definitions.revenue: Gross profit: the admin fee plus the stakers and treasury cuts of the rake. The jackpot cut is excluded because it is paid back out to players.
definitions.holders: Value reaching SEED holders: the fixed 10% of each round's rake flushed to SeedStaking as AAPL yield for stakers, plus the treasury remainder that buys SEED back on the DEX and burns it.

definitions.fees: The 12% taken from every mining round's pot (8% to LUNA stakers, 2% to the Motherlode jackpot, 1% to the Eclipse prize pool, 1% to the protocol), plus the 15% taken from every Eclipse beacon purchase (10% to stakers, 5% to the protocol).
definitions.revenue: ETH distributed to LUNA stakers plus the protocol's retained cut.
definitions.holders: ETH distributed to LUNA stakers — 8% of each mining round pot and 10% of each beacon purchase.

definitions.fees: cardSales (card pack sales) - cardBuybacks (card repurchases) + otherFees (platform fees).
definitions.revenue: Net revenue retained by the protocol after buybacks.

definitions.fees: Protocol fee charged on shielded withdrawals and swaps, always collected in ETH or USDG (ProtocolFeeCharged events), converted to USD.
definitions.revenue: All the fees charged on shielded withdrawals and swaps are retained by the protocol.

definitions.fees: Users pay each pool's configured fee tier on every swap.
definitions.revenue: No protocol fee is taken, all swap fees go to liquidity providers.

definitions.fees: Gross USDC product payments (subscriptions, pay-per-deploy, Architect builds, first-party agent income) entering the on-chain revenue splitter, summed from PaymentSplit events.
definitions.revenue: The protocol's share of every payment — operating, dev, protocol-owned-liquidity reserve and DAO buckets — i.e. gross payments minus third-party affiliate payouts.

definitions.fees: Trade fees on every buy and sell, read directly from the Buy/Sell `fee` field emitted by the contract.
definitions.revenue: Protocol share of trade fees: total fees minus creator cuts emitted via CreatorFeeAccrued.

definitions.fees: Swap fees charged by the KOLSwap protocol.
definitions.revenue: Protocol fee routed to the protocol fee router.

definitions.fees: Borrow interest paid by borrowers on Bitcoin-collateralised USDC loans.
definitions.revenue: Protocol reserve share of borrow interest (reserveRateBps), from the protocolCut field of the InterestAccrued event.

definitions.fees: All ERC-20 payments (0.1% swap fees on AVLT volume, 0.02% on other volume) received by the Yieldzio fee wallet are counted as fees.
definitions.revenue: 100% of fees (0.1% swap fees on AVLT volume, 0.02% on other volume) received by the fee wallet are protocol revenue.

definitions.fees: Users pay a 1% fee in ETH on every bonding-curve buy and sell, plus a one-time 0.001 ETH launch fee per token. After a token graduates (6.9 ETH raised) its liquidity is locked in a full-range Uniswap V3 position whose LP fees accrue to the protocol.
definitions.revenue: 70% of bonding-curve trading fees, all launch fees (0.001 ETH per token), and the claimed LP fees of graduated tokens' locked liquidity positions.

definitions.fees: Trading fees paid by users on card buys/sells (pack primary-mint proceeds are counted as volume, not fees)
definitions.revenue: Trading fees retained by the protocol treasury — fees minus the prize-pool, referral, and creator payouts

definitions.fees: All value received by the Fanex fee wallet on Solana: the 6% fundraise share plus the 1% platform swap fee taken on every fanex_curve buy/sell, the 3% cut on creator dividend distributions, and harvested Raydium CPMM LP fees.
definitions.revenue: All value received by the Fanex fee wallet on Solana: the 6% fundraise share plus the 1% platform swap fee taken on every fanex_curve buy/sell, the 3% cut on creator dividend distributions, and harvested Raydium CPMM LP fees.

definitions.fees: Redemption fees, management fees, performance fees, and elUSD yield distributed to stakers.
definitions.revenue: Redemption fees retained by the treasury wallet, management fees accrued by the vault, and performance fees collected by the vault.

definitions.fees: Total 1% swap fees across all pmav pools on ETH, USDG, and tokenized-stock curves, plus LP fees collected from permanently locked graduated pool positions.
definitions.revenue: Platform's 30% share of swap fees (0.3% per trade).

definitions.fees: USDT distributed as Lista's pre-IPO income to the DAO collection wallet.
definitions.revenue: All pre-IPO income is collected by Lista DAO.

definitions.fees: Trading fees paid by users on AZverse perpetual markets.
definitions.revenue: Perpetual trading fees retained by AZverse after builder revenue shares.

definitions.fees: Platform fee paid by users on every buy/sell swap executed through the Sabre Telegram bot.
definitions.revenue: Trading fees kept by Sabre after referral rewards are paid out.

definitions.fees: Accrued 1% SushiSwap V3 trading fees collected in launch token pools plus fixed gas-token fees paid per token launch.
definitions.revenue: Sushi's share (sushiFeeBps) of accrued V3 trading fees plus fixed launch fees, which belong entirely to Sushi.

definitions.fees: Transfer tax (0.95% default, higher during the anti-whale decay window after launch) charged on every non-exempt transfer of Boardwalk-launched tokens, valued in WETH at the launch pair spot rate. The Uniswap v2 pair fee is not counted.
definitions.revenue: Boardwalk's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps of the 95bps tax, 30bps when a referrer is set), split 10% treasury / 90% governance. Revenue from non-Ethereum chains is bridged weekly to Ethereum, where the split applies (net of bridge fees).
definitions.holders: The portion of the governance 90% recognized when each weekly epoch executes on Ethereum with a holder-accruing outcome chosen by sbfBWLK-weighted votes: BWLK buyback-and-burn or distribution to voters.

definitions.fees: Includes maker and taker fees paid by traders.
definitions.revenue: Part of trading fees retained by the protocol after deducting fees distributed to makers.

definitions.fees: User-paid value from game activity: round admin WETH, WETH vaulted for treasury buybacks (including final-claim settlement rounding dust), ROAR charged for claiming mined rewards early, and AutoMiner execution fees paid to third-party executors.
definitions.revenue: Fees retained by Roar or accruing to ROAR holders through treasury buybacks and permanent dead-address transfers. AutoMiner execution fees are excluded from revenue because they are paid to third-party executors.
definitions.holders: Treasury-vaulted WETH funds ROAR buybacks whose acquired tokens are burned and distributed to stakers. Early-claim ROAR sent to the dead address is also treated as holder revenue through permanent removal from circulation; that transfer does not reduce the token contract's totalSupply.

definitions.fees: Everything users paid the protocol: all native revenue arriving at the chain's fee collector — the PlatformFeeCollector on Robinhood Chain, a bridging collector on each satellite — from the 2% presale service fee, launch tokens' master fee, the bonding pad's 0.5% per-trade skim, the instant-launch fee and the locker's fee-claim cut (FeesReceived logs), PLUS the 10% referrer share carved off the user-attributed streams before they reach the collector (ReferralPaid logs). Satellite revenue is counted on the chain that earned it and excluded from Robinhood when it arrives bridged, so it counts once.
definitions.revenue: The share of fees the protocol keeps: collector receipts only, so the referrer share is excluded. The protocol retains all of it, with the home-chain split between governance holders and the treasury reported under HoldersRevenue / ProtocolRevenue.
definitions.holders: The share of every home-chain distribution delivered to GovernanceToken holders as native-ETH dividends (FeesDistributed logs; distributions happen only on Robinhood Chain).

definitions.fees: Builder code fees paid by users on Hyperliquid perpetual trades executed through SOGO Terminal.
definitions.revenue: Builder code fees collected by SOGO Terminal from Hyperliquid perpetual trades.

definitions.fees: Builder code fees (0.05%) paid by users on Hyperliquid perpetual trades executed through whale.ag.
definitions.revenue: Builder code fees collected by whale.ag from Hyperliquid perpetual trades.

definitions.fees: Protocol-path trading fees accrued into MerryForgeFeeVault (FeeAccrued.receivedAmount; protocolFeeBps on curve + TradeRouter AMM) plus non-refundable USDG create fees (CreateFeeCollected).
definitions.revenue: Protocol shares of FeeVault accruals (protocolCredited) plus create fees. Excludes bond forfeit/slash policy inflows. Creator and referral shares are supply-side (holders/users), not protocol revenue.

definitions.fees: Acquisition fees paid by basket purchasers (net of the slice credited back to them as RIP buying power), settlement fees and retained backing taken from listings, plus the 1% hook fee on every ETH/RIP swap.
definitions.revenue: The protocol's cut of acquisition and settlement fees, retained settlement penalties, and hook swap fees.
definitions.holders: Protocol fees diverted to RIP buybacks.

definitions.fees: Uniswap V3 swap fees generated by Goon-launched pools (pools with under $100 TVL are excluded as dust).
definitions.revenue: The USD share of swap fees, minus whatever Uniswap's protocol fee switch (read live per pool via slot0().feeProtocol) diverts to Uniswap itself.

definitions.fees: Gross gaming revenue (GGR): USDG staked into the pool minus USDG paid out of the pool on positions that settled in the money, both read from the same Transfer logs. Negative on days when payouts exceed stakes.
definitions.revenue: USDG staked into the pool minus USDG paid out on winning positions.

definitions.fees: Trading fees paid by users when executing perps through the Trending interface on Hyperliquid.
definitions.revenue: Builder fees collected by Trending for trades executed through its non-custodial interface.

definitions.fees: Gross gaming revenue: total wagered minus total paid out to players.
definitions.revenue: All gross gaming revenue accrues to the protocol treasury, which acts as the house bankroll.

definitions.fees: All trading fees paid by users
definitions.revenue: All fees are revenue

definitions.fees: Total swap fees paid by traders on Orvex v2 Solidly pools (0.18% volatile / 0.04% stable) and Orvex v4 concentrated liquidity pools.
definitions.revenue: All swap fees are revenue - the LP portion is routed to veORVX voters via the gauge system, and any protocol-fee portion goes to the Orvex treasury.
definitions.holders: Portion of swap fees distributed to veORVX voters through the gauge/FeeDistributor flow (v2: 100% of fees; v4: fee minus protocolFee).

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by users. V2 pools charge a fixed 0.3%; V3 pools use their configured fee tier.
definitions.revenue: Protocol makes no revenue — the protocol-fee switch is currently off.

definitions.fees: Messaging Fees paid by users to cover gas costs for cross-chain messaging, revenue is not calculated as exact costs can't be derived from the logs.
Includes launch fees, curve swap fees and swap fees post graduation (uniswap v4 : realised through fee swept events)
definitions.revenue: Includes all the launch fees and part of swap fees

definitions.fees: The 0.25% fee charged on every trade, taken in whichever token the trader pays with. pools.trade charges nothing to launch a token and takes no cut of the raise. Traders also pay Uniswap's own 0.04% protocol fee on pools where it is switched on; that is Uniswap's charge, not pools.trade's, and is left out here.
definitions.revenue: Zero. pools.trade keeps none of the trading fee — it all goes to the token's creator and back into the pool's own permanently locked liquidity.
definitions.holders: Zero. There is no pools.trade token.

definitions.fees: All betting fees paid across AvaLove game pools = platform fee + creator fee (PlatformFeeCollected + CreatorFeeCollected events, per pool token).
definitions.revenue: Platform's share of fees (PlatformFeeCollected) — accrues to the AvaLove treasury.

definitions.fees: Builder code fees (0.05%) paid by users on Hyperliquid perps trades executed through Liquary.
definitions.revenue: Builder code fees collected by Liquary from Hyperliquid perps trades.

definitions.fees: The bonding-curve trade fee charged on every buy and sell (1.5% of the trade's cost at the time of writing), the fees a token pays out of the ETH it raised when its curve fills and seeds its Uniswap V4 pool, the FactoryHook fee taken on every swap of a Frontier V4 pool (a hook delta on top of the pool's LP fee, so not part of uniswap-v4's fees), and the LP fees of the protocol's permanently locked seed positions, counted on a realized basis when they are collected (Harvester.collect is permissionless, so a collection carries the fees accrued since the previous one and lands on the collection day, not the days they were earned). v1 reconstructs the trade fee from the on-chain txFee timeline and graduation payouts from WETH transfers; v1.2 reads everything exactly from CurveFeeDistributed, GraduationFeesPaid, SwapFeeDistributed and the PolDistributor's FeesDistributed.
definitions.revenue: Protocol revenue across both deployments: on v1, the protocol's 25% of the bonding-curve trade fee net of referrer rewards plus the factory owner's graduation share; on v1.2, the residual share of the trade fee after referrer and creator cuts (creator share owner-tunable via creatorShareBps), the protocol's graduation share, the protocol owner's share of the hook fee on every V4 swap, and the protocol's share of collected seed-position LP fees. Frontier has no protocol token, so there is no holders revenue and Revenue equals ProtocolRevenue.

definitions.fees: Total launch-tax fees emitted by LetsCash hooks through FeeAccrued events. The launch configuration's fee rate is already reflected in the emitted amount.
definitions.revenue: The platform share of launch-tax fees, plus the creator share for self-burn pools because that share buys and burns the launched token.
definitions.holders: 25% of the platform share used to buy and burn CASHCAT, plus 100% of the creator share for self-burn pools.

definitions.fees: Total CHZ staking rewards earned by the CHZ staked through Kayen Finance LST.
definitions.revenue: Protocol fee taken from those rewards, at the rate ProtocolConfig holds at the time of the call.
definitions.holders: No share of the rewards goes to token holders.

definitions.fees: Realized CRSH fees from ProtocolFeeReleased events emitted by the current and legacy parimutuel market contracts. Canceled or waived markets emit no release event and are excluded.
definitions.revenue: All ProtocolFeeReleased USDC is retained by the CRSH protocol.

definitions.fees: All fees paid by users to use a particular Solauncher tool.
definitions.revenue: All fees are collected by Solauncher protocol.

definitions.fees: Fees charged on the value deployed by miners, which fund the outsized rewards pools and the protocol fee.
definitions.revenue: Protocol fee retained by the protocol plus the share reserved for token buybacks & burn and for BTC buybacks paid out as staking rewards.
definitions.holders: Share of the protocol fee reserved for token buybacks & burn and for BTC buybacks paid out as staking rewards.

definitions.fees: Total swap fees paid by traders across all POE pools.
definitions.revenue: POE takes no protocol fee share.
definitions.holders: Money going to governance token holders

definitions.fees: The router-skim fee (feeBps) deducted from swap output on the Junoswap Aggregator Router.
definitions.revenue: All the aggregator fees accrue to the Junoswap protocol treasury.

definitions.fees: The 1% House fee paid by users on swaps executed through HojswapRouterV2, using the exact feeAmount emitted for each trade.
definitions.revenue: All House swap fees are retained by the protocol; there is no supply-side fee allocation.

definitions.fees: All swap fees paid by traders, using each pool's Algebra dynamic fee as it stood at the block of each swap.
definitions.revenue: Swap fees routed out of the pool to the fee vault, taken from each pool's on-chain community fee. This is the veLUTE voters' share.
definitions.holders: Vault-routed swap fees, forwarded through the pool gauge to veLUTE voters. The fee vault sends its entire take to the gauge, so this equals Revenue.

definitions.fees: Pump.fun bonding-curve and PumpSwap trade fees generated by trades placed through the official pump.fun mobile app (transactions invoking the app program). Already counted in the parent pump.fun and PumpSwap listings.
definitions.revenue: Pump's protocol slice of bonding-curve fees plus the PumpSwap protocol fee on app trades.

definitions.fees: Affiliate fees charged on the swaps Vultisig routes natively through THORChain and MayaChain (basis-point affiliate fee per swap), reported by Vultisig's analytics service.
definitions.revenue: All affiliate fees accrue to Vultisig. Referrer cuts are paid by THORChain under the referrer's own THORName and never land on the Vultisig affiliate names.

definitions.fees: All perpetual trading fees paid by users routed through XOX on AZverse.
definitions.revenue: The builder fee share retained by XOX.

definitions.fees: Trading fees paid by users on AZverse spot markets.
definitions.revenue: Spot trading fees retained by AZverse after builder revenue shares.

definitions.fees: EVM token launch fees plus Uniswap v4 LP swap fees harvested from ZNS-launched pools; on Solana, wSOL-denominated Meteora DBC trading, protocol, and routing-referral fees paid by traders in the three wSOL production configs. DBC fees collected in a newly launched base token are excluded because that token cannot be reliably priced.
definitions.revenue: Fees retained by ZNS: EVM launch fees and the exact treasury shares booked by the EVM fee locker; on Solana, the fixed 40% treasury share of ZNS partner trading fees. Solana no-referrer fallback is conservatively excluded until splitter distribution events are indexed by Dune.

definitions.fees: Taker fee (Market.taker_fee_bps, 5 or 10 bps) on all fills. Maker rebate ships 0 and is not paid.
definitions.revenue: Taker fee kept in full (maker rebate ships 0 and is not paid).

definitions.fees: Original INDEX and earn-a-stock taxes settled into stock distributions, plus gross creator-coin taxes harvested by Index Treasuries (Harvested.netCredit plus Harvested.protocolFee).
definitions.revenue: Original INDEX and earn-a-stock distributions settled for $INDEX holders, plus the Index Treasury protocol fee.
definitions.holders: Original INDEX Distributed stock pots and earn-a-stock Cranked deliveries to $INDEX holders.

definitions.fees: Builder code fees (0.05%) paid by users on Hyperliquid perps trades executed through Midas.
definitions.revenue: Builder code fees collected by Midas from Hyperliquid perps trades.

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by users
definitions.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

definitions.fees: The arbitrage profit the hook realises and distributes, summed from the ProfitCurrencyDistribute event the first hook emits on every distribution; for the v2 hook (since 4 October 2026), every leg its executor pays — the swapper's cashback and the LPs' share it declares in ProfitCurrencyDistribute, plus the ProtocolRevenue, ReferralRewarded and PartnerRevenue it pays on top, including on the DELTA integration that shares the executor; plus the profit the HOOKR integration reports in its own ArbitrageProfitSplit and ProfitRecaptured events. The hook closes the price gap a swap opens between connected pools within the same transaction, so this is value recaptured from MEV rather than a fee charged to anyone.
definitions.revenue: The share of that profit retained by the protocol treasury: the executor's ProtocolRevenue event (90% on WTH's own pools, 40% on pools that integrate WTH, since 2 September 2026; on the v2 hook's distributions and on the DELTA integration's, paid on top of the declared amounts) plus any profit donated into WTH's own pools, which was the treasury's income before that event existed. On an arbitrage run by the HOOKR integration it is the wthProtocolAmount leg of the ArbitrageProfitSplit event, and on a recapture the treasuryAmount of the ProfitRecaptured event.

definitions.fees: Builder fees received by Virae.ai from trades on Polymarket v2
definitions.revenue: Builder fees received by Virae.ai from trades on Polymarket v2

definitions.fees: A flat 5000-lamport fee on every Mine instruction plus 5% of every collapsed Caves game pot (SOL side), both paid to the protocol fee wallet.
definitions.revenue: A flat 5000-lamport fee on every Mine instruction plus 5% of every collapsed Caves game pot (SOL side), both paid to the protocol fee wallet.
definitions.holders: 100% of fees (A flat 5000-lamport fee on every Mine instruction plus 5% of every collapsed Caves game pot (SOL side)) fund the daily buyback-and-burn of $MINER.

definitions.fees: Total swap fees paid by users.
definitions.revenue: Share of swap fees collected by the protocol.
definitions.holders: Money going to governance token holders

definitions.fees: Total trading fees from buys and sells plus graduation rewards.
definitions.revenue: Treasury portion of trading fees plus treasury portion of graduation rewards.

definitions.fees: Total swap fees paid by traders in Bonker-launched Uniswap v4 pools: protocol fees realized by the Bonker hooks plus LP fees credited by the Bonker LP locker.
definitions.revenue: Bonker's protocol fee, equal to 20% of the imposed LP fee and paid to the Bonker factory.

definitions.fees: USDG charged to renters when a GPU lease is finalised onchain. Deposits are taken up front but only the time actually consumed is charged; the unused remainder is refunded in the same transaction and is not counted.
definitions.revenue: The protocol's share of each finalised lease, currently 10% of the amount charged.

definitions.fees: 0.3% Uniswap V2 swap fee on the WISE/ETH pair.
definitions.revenue: The pool is ownerless (no admin/team fee switch), so no portion of swap fees is retained as protocol revenue.

definitions.fees: Trading fees StonkFun collects, measured when it claims them: the 1% platform fee on its Raydium LaunchLab bonding curves (every platform config whose fees it claims), the creator fee on the Raydium CPMM pools those launches graduate into, and the quote side of fees harvested from the permanently locked liquidity behind pre-LaunchLab launches. Raydium's own fee shares are excluded. Each token is valued with Dune trade prices at the hour it was received, ignoring trades priced more than 10x away from that day's median.
definitions.revenue: Fees less the creator share of standard launches and the flywheel share of reward launches, as paid out on-chain. From 2026-08-28, fees paid in STONK and fees from STONK's own pool are excluded: they cannot fund a STONK buyback.
definitions.holders: Quote assets spent buying STONK on Jupiter, identified on-chain as swaps that returned STONK to the operator wallet, at the net amount each swap spent.

definitions.fees: All taker fees transferred by the router: the governance-configured protocol fee plus call-scoped integrator fees charged by the official interface.
definitions.revenue: Protocol fees sent to the STATE vault, or to the 2DEEP governor from 2026-09-22, plus official-interface integrator fees.
definitions.holders: Protocol fees sent to the STATE vault for pro-rata redemption by STATE holders, until governance moved the protocol fee to the 2DEEP governor on 2026-09-22.

definitions.fees: Platform fees paid by PRIZM users: 0.85% on swaps routed through Jupiter, collected in the output mint via Jupiter referral fee accounts, and 0.33% on staking, lending and liquidity actions, transferred to the PRIZM fee wallet atomically with the action.
definitions.revenue: All platform fees (0.85% on swaps + 0.33% on staking, lending and liquidity actions) accrue to the protocol; there are no referral or cashback payouts.

definitions.fees: Scoped Rujira adapter covering FIN app-layer fees, the 0.50% RUJI Swap affiliate fee, and gross THORChain bonding rewards earned by bRUNE. Ghost, money market, liquidation, and Index revenue are excluded until supported data sources are available.
definitions.revenue: The Rujira share of FIN fees, the full RUJI Swap affiliate fee, and the 10% bRUNE protocol commission for the covered products.
definitions.holders: Money going to governance token holders

definitions.fees: The protocol surcharge over fair value on settled Pack draws, net of purchaser $FWS-allowance rebates, plus redemption-fee skims on won stock lots and zap entry/exit fees.
definitions.revenue: Protocol cut of pack fees, redemption-fee skims and zap fees, all accruing to the treasury.
definitions.holders: $FWS buybacks funded from the protocol's buyback share and from liquidated redemption skims (burned or redistributed).

definitions.fees: A flat 1% platform fee charged on every swap routed through lockin.
definitions.revenue: All platform fees (1% of the swap's notional value) are kept by lockin — fees collected in the house fee wallets are revenue.
definitions.holders: No fees are distributed to token holders.

definitions.fees: The interface fee LyraSwapRouter charges on the USDC leg of each routed swap (0.20% since deploy), taken from the InterfaceFeeCollected event. Uniswap's LP fee is excluded — it is paid to Uniswap LPs and Lyra cannot capture it.
definitions.revenue: Equal to fees (0.20% of the swap's notional value). There is no supply side: Lyra provides no liquidity for this product, so nothing is shared with LPs.

definitions.fees: Solana: WSOL received by the AgentRanking launch-fee treasury (30% Pump creator-fee share). Robinhood: FeesDistributed on AgentRanking 70/30 creator fee-splitters (creatorAmount + arAmount). Does not count Pump/Uniswap/Quiver TVL.
definitions.revenue: AgentRanking's 30% platform share — Solana treasury WSOL inflows and Robinhood FeesDistributed.arAmount.

definitions.fees: Total interest, redemption fees paid by borrowers and liquidation profit
definitions.revenue: Share of borrow interest to protocol if any

definitions.fees: All trading commission fees (orderbook + AMM), isolated margin add/reduce fees, and net borrowing/imbalance funding fees charged to traders.
definitions.revenue: Actual trading commission transferred to the operation recipient (treasury), matched from the AUSD transfers immediately before each commission event.

definitions.fees: Gross 1% Uniswap V3 trading fees on every token launched through token.select, plus a flat ETH deployment fee per launch and a migration fee charged when a launch graduates to a live pool.
definitions.revenue: The platform's share of token/WETH pool trading fees (serviceChargeRate on each token, currently 20%), the whole of every token/$SELECT pool fee harvest, which the factory transfers in full to the treasury, plus all deployment and migration fees.

definitions.fees: Swap volume multiplied by each pool's on-chain fee tier (the pools mapping stores it as parts per million).
definitions.revenue: The protocol's cut of the swap fee, fee_protocol/16 per the pool's on-chain slots entry.

definitions.fees: Builder Fees collected from Orderly Network
definitions.revenue: All the fees collected

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by users, using the dynamic fee carried in each Swap event.
definitions.revenue: No protocol fee is enabled yet.
definitions.holders: Money going to governance token holders

definitions.fees: Trading fees on every bonding-curve buy/sell plus token launch fees, collected on-chain at the two topblast.lol fee wallets (UQClgkR0eLgWAR0tZh8YbQyDqa-Jn5wUP1XHPLDB6RmAPySF and UQDu4AiT__JKuqT0Znje0RoXIQMPcj4uIGYZme3UK4hFlE_Q). Wallet-to-wallet transfers and failed transactions are excluded. Trading fees are capped at 1% of volume; any remainder is launch fees.
definitions.revenue: 100% of collected fees(trading fees + launch fees) are retained by the protocol. Creator and deployer fees are claimed directly on-chain by those wallets and never reach the protocol fee wallets, so they are not counted.
definitions.holders: 0 — no fees are distributed to token holders.

definitions.fees: $KINS paid by players: full paid-spinner payments (50% burned, 50% to treasury) plus the 5% treasury fee on marketplace gold-for-$KINS sales.
definitions.revenue: All fees accrue to the protocol side: burned $KINS plus $KINS retained by treasury.
definitions.holders: 50% of every paid spinner payment is burned, reducing $KINS supply.

definitions.fees: Gross gaming revenue: the total staked by players in settled rounds minus the total paid out to them.
definitions.revenue: Performance fee taken by the protocol on the bankroll's profit above its high water mark (50% of the eligible gain).

definitions.fees: Builder code fees paid by users on Hyperliquid perps trades executed through Quote.
definitions.revenue: Builder code fees collected by Quote from Hyperliquid perps trades.

definitions.fees: Users pay each pool's configured fee tier (0.05%, 0.3% or 1%) on every swap.
definitions.revenue: No protocol fee is taken (feeProtocol is 0 on every pool), all swap fees go to liquidity providers.

definitions.fees: Users pay a 0.3% fee on every swap.
definitions.revenue: No protocol fee is taken (factory feeTo is unset), all swap fees go to liquidity providers.

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by users on each trade.
definitions.revenue: 10% of collected fees is protocol revenue.

definitions.fees: 1.50% of the ETH leg of every trade, taken by the InstantHook and split between creators and the Agen treasury.
definitions.revenue: Agen treasury's 0.50% share of every trade, credited to the platform.

definitions.fees: 1.50% of every bonding curve trade, charged on the quote side. Covers all four legs the curve program reports: the user.fun partner share, the coin creator share, Meteora's protocol share and the referral share paid to whichever interface hosted the swap.
definitions.revenue: The user.fun partner share only, which is 0.90% of a trade: the 1.20% the curve accumulates after Meteora's protocol share, less the coin creator's 25% of it. user.fun's own configuration records an effective rate of 0.96%, which is this 0.90% plus the 0.06% referral leg Meteora returns to whichever interface hosted the swap. That leg is counted in Fees and not here, because the swap event does not name the referral account and so cannot show which trades it was ours to claim.

definitions.fees: Per-coin trading fees of 1%-4% per side, chosen by each creator at launch and immutable afterwards, the 0.25% trader/holder reward leg when a RewardVault is wired, and the fixed rewards paid out when a coin graduates. The share of each fee used to buy back and burn the launched coin is netted out rather than counted.
definitions.revenue: The protocol's share of trading fees, including the portion deferred until a coin graduates and the 25% treasury cut of above-default fee tiers, plus the protocol's graduation reward.

definitions.fees: Includes Pump.fun creator/partner fee shares earned on every coin launched using the protocol and $ANSEM tokens burned to unlock launch tiers.
definitions.revenue: Captured pump.fun fee shares and platform payments plus $ANSEM tier burns.
definitions.holders: $ANSEM permanently burned for Gold/Diamond launch tiers, accruing to remaining $ANSEM holders.

definitions.fees: Trading fees paid by users on Hyperliquid markets deployed by Entropy.
definitions.revenue: Half of the fees goes to the protocol and rest to hyperliquid

definitions.fees: Report submission fees and identity verification fees paid by security researchers to Immunefi's fee collector wallet.
definitions.revenue: All fees collected go to Immunefi.

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by traders across all STONX Ve33 pools.
definitions.revenue: All STONX Ve33 swap fees are routed to veSTONX voters. The protocol treasury takes no share.
definitions.holders: All swap fees are allocated to veSTONX voters in proportion to the voting power assigned to each pool.

definitions.fees: Total LP trading fees claimed by managed positions (Meteora DLMM and DAMM v2 on Solana, Uniswap V3 on Robinhood Chain). LP Agent's on-chain footprint is only the 8% commission, so gross claimed fees are back-calculated as commission / 0.08.
definitions.revenue: The 8% commission LP Agent takes on claimed LP fees — at claim time and on the fee portion of a decrease or close, never on position principal. Measured as transfers into the per-chain fee wallet. LP Agent retains all of it.

definitions.fees: Builder Fees collected from Orderly Network
definitions.revenue: All the fees collected

definitions.fees: Hook fees charged on the quote leg of every swap in Coinbarrel-launched Uniswap V4 pools (flat platform fee plus the creator-configured fee, read per swap from the hook's QuoteFeeAccrued event), Uniswap LP fees swept from the permanently locked launch positions, the fixed 0.0005 ETH launch service fee, and the legacy pre-V5 streams: the 1% LP fee on the Simple launches' Uniswap V3 pools and the per-swap fees of the legacy Advanced hooks.
definitions.revenue: The platform share that ends up in the Coinbarrel treasury: the platform bucket of the hook fee (counted when it accrues; the fee router pays it out in batches), the treasury share of LP fees (30% on Simple launches, per the FeeLocker split), and launch fees. Nothing of the creator fee reaches Coinbarrel.

definitions.fees: fee_bps (StreamService::GetConfig, currently 250 = 2.5%) on each new wVARA stream's deposited amount. Counted on the stream's start_time, so days with no new streams are 0.
definitions.revenue: All streaming fees (currently 2.5%) go to the protocol treasury.

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by users
definitions.revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

definitions.fees: All user-paid slices on key trades and fund dispatch: platform + creator + trading-fund + $3 dispatch. Exclusive of bonding-curve price. Performance / bridge fees on FriendStake clones are not counted in v1 (beacon clones; 0 recent distributions).
definitions.revenue: Platform slices of key-trade fees plus flat dispatch fees paid to the protocol treasury.

definitions.fees: Swap fees on each venture's Uniswap v4 spot pool, booked in the money token at each swap's realised price, plus the fees of the winning proposal in each decision market, recognised when its protocol cut is collected after settlement. Fees paid on losing proposals never become real tokens and are not counted.
definitions.revenue: What accrues to the protocol fee recipient: the protocol cut of spot and winning-proposal decision-market fees, plus the recipient's share of the LP half through vault shares it holds.
definitions.holders: None. No buyback, burn or staker distribution exists on-chain.

definitions.fees: Everything paid to trade on Ride Markets, in USDC: a fee when a trade is opened, a fee when it settles, and the share of the profit paid to the caller who deployed the trade.
definitions.revenue: The opening and settlement fees, which the protocol keeps.

definitions.fees: Yield generated by mxHYPE's borrowed-USDC overlay on Hyperliquid Core, measured in HYPE at distribution via the HypeVault's YieldDistributed event, plus instant redeem/unstake fees paid by users.
definitions.revenue: Share of distributed yield routed to the foundation, plus instant redeem/unstake fees. The insurance-fund share is booked as supply-side revenue because it backstops the system.

definitions.fees: Staking rewards from staked SOL on phase delegation staked solana, plus withdrawal fees
definitions.revenue: 5% epoch fee on staking rewards plus 0.05% withdrawal fees collected by the fee collector

definitions.fees: Treasury-bound pair commission (swap + book take + limit place) plus labeled wrap/window fees. spread_amount and community-tax extra-debit are not fees.
definitions.revenue: Treasury commission credited to the protocol on swaps, book takes, limit placements, wrap/unwrap, and UST1 mint/redeem. Excludes LP spread and community-tax debits.

definitions.fees: Platform fees and launch taxes paid by users trading on Ignix bonding curves.
definitions.revenue: The platform-fee portion retained by Ignix.

definitions.fees: Successful mainnet round-settlement fees calculated from the BidGrid ResetEvent allocation fields. User deposits, payouts and premine transfers are not counted as fees.
definitions.revenue: Gross profit from BidGrid round fees after excluding the jackpot amount paid back to winning miners.
definitions.holders: Round-fee allocations assigned to BDGR buybacks, BDGR staking rewards and the Burn Pot.

definitions.fees: 0.05% protocol fee deducted from order inputs at placement.
definitions.revenue: The 0.05% protocol fee, retained by the gateway.

definitions.fees: Swap fees charged on Hookers launches, in native ETH. A creator picks a launch style from the protocol's mechanism registry. Hooked styles skim a directional buy/sell fee inside the hook, set by the creator between 100 and 1000 bps. Hookless styles use the pool's own Uniswap v4 LP fee, collected through LiquidityCustody. The registry is read on chain, so styles added later are included automatically.
definitions.revenue: The 30 bps protocol fee routed to FeeRouter, plus the share spent buying back and burning HKRS, the protocol's own token.
definitions.holders: HKRS bought back and burned, valued in ETH. This covers the automatic buyback hook on the HKRS pool, plus the discretionary buybacks the team runs out of the protocol's fee share, which are measured from the HKRS burned and priced from the HKRS pool. Buybacks on third-party launches are excluded and counted as supply side, since they accrue to those tokens' holders. Discretionary buybacks are funded from fees already counted as protocol revenue, so this figure overlaps ProtocolRevenue rather than adding to Revenue.

definitions.fees: Swap fees charged by Cantex pools (pool fee rate applied to each swap), denominated in CC.
definitions.revenue: The protocol's share of swap fees (per-pool admin fee share).

definitions.fees: All fee legs charged on trades, measured from on-chain token transfers out of the router: protocol commission (including captured surplus), aggregation fees, keeper execution fees and referral fees. All fees are paid by traders out of trade proceeds.
definitions.revenue: Protocol commission and aggregation fees, both collected by protocol-owned collectors.

definitions.fees: Position fees paid after trading discounts, plus borrowing, liquidation, and UI fees. Funding transfers between traders are excluded.
definitions.revenue: The position, borrowing, and liquidation fee amounts accrued as claimable protocol fees and withdrawable through FeeHandler.

definitions.fees: Maker and taker trading fees on Native Core CLOB fills. Each side pays independently, so both legs are counted. Taken from GET /api/v3/stats/window over the hour. Settlement assets are recorded under their Native Core registry token; CLOB-only synthetic assets without a canonical token are valued from their USDC/USDT market.
definitions.revenue: Maker and taker fees Native retains after subtracting Native Pool yield distributed to LPs. Revenue can be negative in a distribution hour because Pool payouts include extra rewards as well as fee-funded yield.

definitions.fees: XAGm custody fees and redemption fees.
definitions.revenue: XAGm custody and redemption fees accounted as protocol revenue.

definitions.fees: Per-pool swap fee read from PoolFactory.getFee (default vAMM 0.30% / sAMM 0.05%, customizable per pool) applied to each swap, plus external bribes deposited by third parties to voter-incentive contracts.
definitions.revenue: veRAPH voters’ take: staked-LP swap fees forwarded to voters plus external bribes. Equals HoldersRevenue — Raphael keeps no treasury cut of swap fees.
definitions.holders: Swap fees from staked LPs (fee × pool.balanceOf(gauge) / pool.totalSupply), forwarded to veRAPH voters, plus external bribes.

definitions.fees: 2% protocol fee charged on each settlement (jobs via escrow, campaigns via campaign vault), paid in USDC/USDT to the protocol fee recipient.
definitions.revenue: 100% of protocol fees (2% of settlements) go to the protocol fee recipient.

definitions.fees: 1% pool swap fee on every trade, accruing to permanently locked Uniswap V4 positions and periodically swept to creators and the protocol, plus a 0.0005 ETH launch fee paid at each token deployment.
definitions.revenue: 30% of collected swap fees credited to the treasury claimable balance, plus the full 0.0005 ETH launch fee paid to the protocol treasury at launch.

definitions.fees: Trading fees paid by users on swaps routed through the Archade app, plus bonding curve trade fees and pool creation fees on coins launched through Archade. Fees after a coin graduates to a DEX pool are not included yet.
definitions.revenue: Archade's platform fee on app swaps, its share of bonding curve trade fees, and its share of pool creation fees.
definitions.holders: None. Archade has no token.

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by users
Total yields from deposited assets in all curated vaults.
definitions.revenue: Yields are collected by curators.

definitions.fees: SOL fees paid by users for Rapid Launch token deployment and trading tools.
definitions.revenue: 86% of collector fees, kept by Rapid Launch after the 14% referral split.

definitions.fees: The 1.5% swap fee charged by SolStockerFeeHook on every swap in a SolStocker-launched Uniswap v4 pool, read per swap from the five slices of the FeeCharged event and denominated in the pool's quote asset (a tokenized equity such as SPCX or NVDA). There is no launch fee and no graduation fee.
definitions.revenue: The 0.30% platform slice plus the 0.15% slice owed to STOCKER holders — 0.45% of the trade, 30% of the fee.
definitions.holders: The 0.15% slice accruing to holders of STOCKER, SolStocker's own token — 10% of the fee. It accrues to a dedicated recipient separate from platform revenue and is settled to STOCKER holders on Solana.

definitions.fees: Everything borrowers pay: the flat fee charged when a loan is opened or extended, penalties paid when a loan is cured after its grace period, and the protocol's cut of any appreciation on yield-bearing collateral. Lodestar charges no interest, so nothing accrues over the life of a loan.
definitions.revenue: The portion of the above kept by the protocol: the reserve cut of borrower fees, plus all penalties and all collateral yield skim.

definitions.fees: Interest paid by borrowers
definitions.revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury

definitions.fees: Builder-code fees paid by users on Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome trades placed through the builder code.
definitions.revenue: Builder-code fees on Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome trades, all kept by the builder.

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by traders on every Ilyris swap, a base fee per pool plus a variable fee that rises while the market is volatile.
definitions.revenue: The protocol's share of swap fees (10% on every pool since launch), sent to the pool's fee recipient wallet.
definitions.holders: Money going to governance token holders

definitions.fees: Settlement FeeCollected plus partner fees on tagged CoW, UniswapX, and Velora fills.
definitions.revenue: 100% of Settlement, UniswapX, and Velora fees. 75% of CoW partner fees (CIP-75).

definitions.fees: Loopr basket mint fees (paid in-kind by minters, in the basket's own constituent tokens), the LOOPR-token creator + protocol tax collected via launchpad hook, and ETH deposited into Loopr's community vault.
definitions.revenue: Loopr's 30% cut of each basket's mint fee, the LOOPR token creator + protocol tax paid to Loopr's own wallet, and ETH deposited into Loopr's community vault.

definitions.fees: Pez curve trade fees and creator taxes on every launched token, plus the graduated Uniswap v4 pool fees of the PEZ platform token, realized through PoolFeesSwept events. Other graduated pools are counted under the Uniswap v4 listing. Pez's current deployment has no launch fee.
definitions.revenue: Protocol revenue plus holders revenue.
definitions.holders: PEZ buyback-and-lock amounts reported by PoolFeesSwept for the PEZ pool. No such buyback has happened on-chain so far, so this is currently zero.

definitions.fees: 0.25% protocol fee per swap, taken in ETH when ETH/WETH is on either side, otherwise in the output token.
definitions.revenue: All fees (0.25% of the swap volume) go to the protocol treasury.

definitions.fees: Swap fees on the listed DLMM and DAMM factories plus WETH credited to U1 lockers. Excludes aggregator, keeper, flash-loan and liquidity-composition fees. DLMM uses SwapDetailed; DAMM uses changes in protocol and LP fee accumulators plus claims, in each historical fee token.
definitions.revenue: The protocol's share of swap fees accruing to the fee recipient, plus WETH credited to U1 lockers (including external funding).
definitions.holders: Actual WETH distributions credited to U1 lockers (Base) by RewardsAdded, including external funding. Counted in Fees and Revenue at funding time, not again when users claim. No fixed forwarding percentage is assumed.

definitions.fees: AMM swap commission only: for each hourly volume_bucket on factory pairs (reflective + cumulative), fee = offer_volume * live pair.commission_rate (fee asset = offer asset). Excludes token_bonding wrap/unwrap and converter pairs. $WESO cw20_bonding curve tax_collected is cumulative-only (project_tax_pct 10) with no time-bucketed query, so curve taxes are NOT included. Buckets retain at most 168 hours.
definitions.revenue: fee_collector_share_permille of the AMM commission (live per pair; sampled pairs are 1000 = 100%) sent to fee_collector terra1wkdm6wcm4srahrvp09jea7csfq3yuacc4gmyft6p6n6pls9wy5js9lqhqq. No separate LP share of this commission field is counted — reflective pools may compensate LPs via the curve, not this commission — so SupplySideRevenue is omitted.
definitions.holders: Money going to governance token holders

definitions.fees: Trading commission collected on perp trades (funding payments excluded).
definitions.revenue: Trading commission retained by the protocol after referral rebates (fees − rebates).
definitions.holders: Fees going to governance token holders

definitions.fees: Taker trading fees: each market's taker_fee_ppm (0.1% on most markets) applied to that market's volume. Maker fees are not charged to takers and are excluded.
definitions.revenue: All trading fees are collected by the protocol. Partner commissions and trader fee rebates are paid from the treasury after the fact and are not netted here.

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by traders on the protocol's BUCKET/ETH Uniswap v4 pool: the 1% LP fee plus the BucketFeeHook's 3% Treasury fee (FEE_BPS is a verified on-chain constant), both measured on the ETH leg of each Swap event; plus the Stockback router's 0.5% input fee (exact per-swap amount from its Swapped event).
definitions.revenue: The hook's 3% Treasury fee, the 1% LP fee (the pool's liquidity is protocol-owned and permanently locked), and the protocol half of Stockback router fees.
definitions.holders: The hook's 3% Treasury fee plus the protocol half of router fees: this is the stream the payout engine converts into tokenized stocks delivered to BUCKET holder wallets. Keeper gas for those deliveries is paid from this stream and varies with chain conditions; it is not modeled as a fixed split.

definitions.fees: Trading fees charged on every curve buy and sell (1% of the quote amount on the active preset: 0.8% creator, 0.2% protocol).
definitions.revenue: Protocol share of curve trading fees (0.2%).

definitions.fees: Actual protocol and creator trading fees from Trade, plus the graduationFee from Graduated. Accrual basis in native SHIDO, valued using its 1:1 WSHIDO wrapper. No fixed fee-rate estimates, claim double-counting, gas fees or post-graduation fees.
definitions.revenue: Protocol trading fees plus graduation fees, excluding the creator trading-fee share and all post-graduation revenue.

definitions.fees: The protocol fee taken from every round's tile deposits (10% at launch, read per round from the RoundClosed event) plus the full winning bid of every weekly tile ad auction, paid in SOL or ATTN. Player deposits are paid out to winning bidders and are not counted.
definitions.revenue: The round protocol fee plus 10% of each winning SOL ad bid and all of each winning ATTN ad bid, sent to the protocol treasury.

definitions.fees: Builder code fees paid on Hyperliquid trades routed through AlphaPilot; excludes Hyperliquid exchange trading fees.
definitions.revenue: Builder code fees collected by AlphaPilot from Hyperliquid trades.

definitions.fees: Users pay fees on each swap.
definitions.revenue: The protocol receives 20% of the fees paid by users.

definitions.fees: Native ETH creator rewards claimed from PonsV2FeeEscrow for World is Flat ($WIF).
definitions.revenue: 100% of claimed Pons creator rewards are retained by the WIF treasury.

definitions.fees: Everything borrowers and traders pay on gage: the deal or origination fee taken when a loan funds, trade fees on sold reclaim rights and lender units, the cash-out platform fee, and the borrower's fixed cost paid to lenders at repayment (repayment cap minus principal). Fixed-cost loans have no interest accrual: the cost is booked when the loan is repaid. Intent lend-asset generations lend a stock token, and their amounts are in that token.
definitions.revenue: Deal, origination, trade and cash-out fees, the Earn performance fee on lender returns, and on Intent V1 the execution fee each fill takes from the partner vaults' return and the protocol's 10% of a partner vault's performance fee.
definitions.holders: Deal, origination, trade and cash-out fees, the Intent execution fee and the protocol's share of partner vault performance fees: since D57 every one of them buys GAGE for the permanent GAGE-only floor bands of the GAGE/sGAGE pool.

definitions.fees: The protocol fee on every referral bounty that pays out: 10% of the reward, paid by the referrer.
definitions.revenue: All protocol fees (10% of referral rewards) go to the ref_market treasury.

definitions.fees: Swap fees (1% of the swap) and optional creator tax charged by the Cook hook on every swap, before and after graduation, there is no launch fee
definitions.revenue: Part of the swap fees (protocolFeeShareBps, 10% at launch) sent to the Cook treasury

definitions.fees: Includes 2% property NFT sale fees and interest earned from property NFTs.
definitions.revenue: Includes 2% property NFT sale fees and 10% of interest earned from property NFTs.

definitions.fees: The tax BaseStonk's Uniswap v4 hook takes on every swap in a launched token's pool, from the hook's FeeTaken event. Each launch sets its own buy and sell rate. A buy pays the tax in the launch token and a sell in the pair; token-denominated amounts are converted into the pair at the pool price the same transaction's Swap reports.
definitions.revenue: The platform's cut of the tax plus what reaches BSTONK holders: half the tax capped at 1% of the trade to the treasury, any part of the creator's cut the payee list left unplaced and the hook swept to the treasury, and the share of the creator's cut paid to BSTONK's dividend distributor, to the BSTONK basket vault, or burnt as BSTONK.
definitions.holders: Value to BSTONK holders, paid by the hook in the transaction the fee was taken: BSTONK's own pool pays its creator cut to BSTONK's dividend distributor and burns half of it, and launches carry the BSTONK basket vault as a payee; the vault pays BSTONK holders in rounds. Base only - BSTONK lives on Base.

definitions.fees: Gross LP trading fees claimed by Valhalla-managed Meteora DLMM positions. Each public Meteora claim event is counted only when its transaction contains Valhalla's matching post-workflow management-fee transfer; claim assets are measured directly, not inferred from a fee rate. DAMM v2 and opening fees are excluded.

0.35% redeem fee on private transfers (withheld from the gross amount before zAssets are minted to the recipient, live since 2026-06-02) plus liquidity-based unwrap fees charged by the LiquidityManagers.
definitions.revenue: All fees (redeem and unwrap) are retained by the protocol: the redeem fee is never minted, and unwrap fees accrue to the LiquidityManager fee surplus.

definitions.fees: Total swap fees paid by traders. Per-pool fee rate read from CLPool.fee() applied to each swap's input amount.
definitions.revenue: veRAPH voters’ take: staked-LP swap fees plus the unstaked-LP rake (CLPool.unstakedFee), plus external bribes. Equals HoldersRevenue — Raphael keeps no treasury cut of swap fees.
definitions.holders: Fees earned by staked liquidity (CLPool.stakedLiquidity / liquidity) plus the rake taken from unstaked liquidity, forwarded to veRAPH voters, plus external bribes.

definitions.fees: Everything users pay the protocol: the price of every cat minted, the trading fee the hook takes on the $HASH pool, and the secondary-market royalty the collection routes to the hook. The mint price is derived per cat from the contract's own curve - the number of cats created so far times PRICE_STEP - rather than read from a transaction value, so a mint sent with excess ether cannot inflate it.
definitions.revenue: Fees minus the rent paid out to living cats.
definitions.holders: The share of revenue that joins the hook's buyback queue and is spent buying $HASH back on the pool and burning it. Measured at the fee source - the moment the hook receives and splits the money - rather than when a buyback executes, since the queue is drained gradually under a per-block cap.

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by users
Flat SOL fees paid by users to create a token, manage a token, create an OpenBook market and bulk send tokens on DexLab, received by the DexLab fee wallet on Solana.
definitions.revenue: All fees (SOL paid by users to create a token, manage a token, create an OpenBook market and bulk send tokens on DexLab) are kept by DexLab. There is no supplier side and no token holder share.

definitions.fees: The 1% hook fee and the ~3.33% tax PonsV2MemeHook charges on every swap of the genesis SHROOM/MU pool, read from the hook's own sweep events and denominated in MU after the hook converts the SHROOM side. Neither rate is assumed: both come from the events, and the split between Pons and the creator is read from the hook at the block being priced.
definitions.revenue: SHROOM token revenue only: MU allocated for holder dividends in pool-filtered sweeps, excluding Pons. This is not treasury revenue and includes no treasury LP earnings.
definitions.holders: MU allocated to all SHROOM holders from creatorAmount, recognized at the hook sweep. Actual recipient payments can occur later. Treasury holders are included in this token-wide allocation, so do not add treasury dividend receipts again.

definitions.fees: Treasury income only: earned fees from treasury-owned SHROOM LP positions plus actual MU dividend receipts. Token balances and returned LP principal are not income. All-holder SHROOM dividend allocations are reported separately in shroom.ts; do not sum the two scopes.
definitions.revenue: Treasury income only: earned fees from treasury-owned SHROOM LP positions plus actual MU dividend receipts. Token balances and returned LP principal are not income. All-holder SHROOM dividend allocations are reported separately in shroom.ts; do not sum the two scopes.

definitions.fees: Protocol fee plus judge fee, both charged on the pot when the winner claims.
definitions.revenue: The protocol fee share of claims, paid to the protocol fee collector.
definitions.holders: Zero. There is no token.

definitions.fees: Commission charged by the validators kHYPE delegates to, on the staking rewards they produce for kHYPE.
definitions.revenue: The half of that commission Kinetiq invoices back to each validator operator (invoice_rate_bps, 5000 to date).
definitions.holders: 70% of the invoiced amount, used to buy back KNTQ for sKNTQ holders from 2026-04-09.

definitions.fees: Sum of `fee` fields from `OptionExercised` (settlement fee on each exercised leg) and `PositionClosed` (matched-pair close fee). Both are charged at `1 / sf_fee_divisor` of the exercised/closed collateral and paid in USDC.
definitions.revenue: Equal to Fees (sum of `OptionExercised` and `PositionClosed` fees): the protocol has no governance token, and every fee is transferred to the on-chain `feeCollector_address` (which the owner can rotate via `setFeeCollector` / `FeeCollectorChanged`).

definitions.fees: Trading fees paid in KNTQ on Hyperliquid spot, which is the side of a KNTQ trade the HIP-1 deployer's share applies to.
definitions.revenue: All of the trading fees paid in KNTQ on Hyperliquid spot. deployerTradingFeeShare on KNTQ is 1.0, so the deployer keeps the whole KNTQ-denominated fee.

definitions.fees: 5.5% platform fee on marketplace resales + 2.5% platform fee on rental payments + the 2.5% creator royalty on resales, which is passed through to the original creator rather than kept by the protocol.
definitions.revenue: Only the treasury-bound platform fees (resale + rental). Excludes the creator royalty.

definitions.fees: Curve mode: 1% base fee plus optional creator tax on every bonding-curve buy/sell, plus the flat (owner-adjustable, re-read live) launch fee, plus post-graduation Uniswap v4 pool fees realised at sweep. Instant-v4 mode: the 1% LP fee of SolonPad's own plain Uniswap v4 launch pools, realised when the permissionless FeeSplitter crank forwards it.
definitions.revenue: Curve mode: the protocol's share of curve fees (per-token policy, read live) plus all launch fees. Instant-v4 mode: the ~50% of LP fees forwarded to the platform treasury.

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by traders: each swap's amount times its pool's fee rate. Pools with a dynamic-fee plugin set the rate inside every swap without emitting it, so the rate is read from slot0 at the end of each hourly window.
definitions.revenue: The protocol's share of swap fees, set per pool and per token in basis points of the fee.

definitions.fees: Creation fees, curve trading fees, anti-snipe surcharge, graduation fees, and leftover quote at graduation. Excludes Lunya DEX swap fees.
definitions.revenue: Creation fees, the protocol share of curve fees, the full anti-snipe surcharge, graduation fees minus the trigger reward, and leftover quote at graduation.

definitions.fees: Swap fees paid by users
Launch fees, curve trading fees, snipe tax, creator tax and swap fees from graduated Uniswap v3 pools (realised when swept).
definitions.revenue: All launch fees plus the protocol share of curve trading fees, snipe tax and graduated pool swap fees.

definitions.fees: Trading fees from Peach bonding-curve trades and the launchpad's cut of graduated-pool LP fees, including creator tax, counted once when the fee accrues. Fees without a USD price are excluded.
definitions.revenue: The platform's own share of fees, after creator, partner, referral and launched-token buyback shares.

definitions.fees: Everything traders pay copyfomo on every copied buy and sell (a 2% service fee plus the gas copyfomo fronts for them, billed back as one stablecoin transfer to the copyfomo treasury, counted on the day the fee is collected), plus the creator fees of the copyfomo token $COPY: the Pons launchpad hook takes 3% of every swap of the COPY/COIN pool on Robinhood Chain, of which 2.7% goes to the creator (1% hook fee, 70% to the creator, plus a 2% creator tax). Counted on the day of the trade, valued at the hourly COIN price. The fees are swept into COIN by Pons and claimed by copyfomo in batches later; the claims are not what is counted.
definitions.revenue: Fees minus SupplySideRevenue, i.e. after the EVM bundler gas, the Solana fee payer cost and referral rewards: the service fee plus copyfomo's margin on gas, plus the $COPY creator fees (the 'token fees' figure on copyfomo.com/data). The 'protocol fees, after gas' figure on copyfomo.com/data is the service part before referral rewards.
definitions.holders: Buyback & burn of $COPY, funded by the creator fees: what the copyfomo creator wallets pay (COIN or USDG) in every transaction where they buy $COPY from the pool and burn $COPY in the same transaction (the buyback account buys and burns in one user operation). Counted on the day of the buy, which follows the trades that generated the fees. A holder cashback leg (USDG distributed to $COPY holders) is planned and will be added when it goes live.

definitions.fees: Fees paid by users on heks: a fee on every swap in a launched coin's pool, plus the flat fee a creator pays to launch one. The swap fee is charged in the pool's pair asset. It is the protocol fee — 1% in steady state, higher in a launch's first ten seconds to price out snipers — plus, on coins launched from V2.2 whose creator set one, a creator tax of up to 10%. Both are read from the vault's own events: Collected carries the protocol fee and its split, TaxCredited the creator tax.
definitions.revenue: The protocol's 30% share of every swap's protocol fee, plus the launch fee in full. The creator tax is never shared with the protocol.

definitions.fees: Actual MON fees accrued to the protocol treasury and sent to the buyback vault at round settlement, plus separately paid auto-bet gas subsidies. Excludes MON allocated back to players and does not count gross stakes as fees.
definitions.revenue: MON round settlement fees retained by the treasury and buyback vault; excludes auto-bet execution fees paid to the gas-subsidy wallet.
definitions.holders: Successful GONE staking rewards funded by the buyback vault, valued in MON at the matching buyback's actual execution rate (MON spent / GONE bought), then priced in USD by the SDK. Includes pending rewards only when successfully funded; excludes mining allocations, no-staker treasury diversions, other funders and later claims. Execution-price valuation includes trading costs and is not an independent GONE market price.

definitions.fees: USDC-side Uniswap V3 swap fees accrued on Tolly's locked launch pools. Excludes the project-token-side fee leg, which is burned outright but has no reliable USD price.
definitions.revenue: The 10% protocol-treasury share plus the 9% spent buying and burning TOLLY.
definitions.holders: The 9% share market-bought back into TOLLY and burned.

definitions.fees: 1% total fee on every Sashimi bonding-curve trade, read directly from each trade's own fee amount, plus the flat 1 USDC launch fee. Excludes post-graduation Uniswap v3 fees, which are not yet tracked here.
definitions.revenue: 60% of the curve trading fee, per the documented protocol/creator split, plus all launch fees.

definitions.fees: 1% trading fee on RadarDEX Reflection-launch pools, always denominated in USDC regardless of the pool's own quote asset, read from each fee distribution event.
definitions.revenue: None. RadarDEX takes no cut of Reflection-launch fees; the entire 1% goes to the launched token's holders and its deployer.

definitions.fees: The full swap fee on every ubi.fun trade: the creator and protocol legs from FeeEscrow, plus the USDC-denominated half of referral payouts.
definitions.revenue: The team's 15% share of the total swap fee, confirmed on-chain against a real PlatformFeeSplitter distribution.

definitions.fees: The fee a V5 or V6 launch pool charges on each trade, taken by that launch's hook inside the swap itself and read from the hook's own event, so the rate is never assumed here.
